tooltips.status: Based on when the learner was last active anywhere: Active within 14 days, At risk 15–30 days, Dormant over 30 days, Never started if they have never done anything. All-time, not affected by the period above.

tooltips.pointsPerMinute: Roleplay score earned per minute of practice, in the selected period — it separates a learner who scores steadily from one who only accumulates minutes. Can be negative, because roleplay scores can go below zero. Blank until the learner has at least 10 practice minutes, since below that the ratio is too noisy to be meaningful.
tooltips.itemsCompletedPct: Course items completed out of every item in the courses this learner is enrolled in, including items they have not unlocked yet. All-time. Counted per item, not per course, so progress through a long course still shows.
tooltips.quizzes: Quiz items passed, out of those they have attempted, and in brackets the average of their most recent graded attempt on each — so repeated failures show rather than being hidden by a later pass. All-time.
tooltips.readWatch: Article and video items completed. All-time.
tooltips.reflection: Journal, annotation and game items completed. All-time.
tooltips.coursesCompleted: Courses finished end to end, and in brackets that as a share of the courses they are enrolled in. All-time.

sections.heading: General Terms (All Users)
content: You are 18+ and legally able to enter contracts
You are accessing Ally through a partner organization formally engaged with Ally or through direct invitation by Ally for demonstration, testing or research purposes.
You are using Ally’s platform in accordance with your affiliated organization’s rules, ethics and requirements.
You understand that Ally is NOT for real emergencies. Contact crisis services, if needed. More information: https://findahelpline.com/

sections.heading: For Ally Skills Lab (Training Simulations)
content: You understand that all the scenarios are fictional, and for training purposes only.
You understand that this doesn't replace human-supervised training, provide certification, or qualify you for independent practice.
You consent to audio and transcripts of role-play sessions being stored for quality improvement and being shared with your training organization/supervisor.

content: You will use this only for authorized sessions per your organization's rules
For this product, audio recordings are NOT stored by Ally. Transcripts of sessions are stored and deleted based on the user organization’s decision

controlsByGame.TREX_RUNNER: Press space or tap to jump. Nothing here is scored.

controlsByGame.CUB_N_PUP: Drag the cub along the links to the star. Drag anywhere else to turn the whole grid. Boards you solve are counted, and the count goes nowhere.

controlsByGame.SPROUT: Press and drag the can over the soil, or use the arrow keys and hold space. Keep the level inside the green band — too much water is as bad as too little. Nothing here is scored towards the course.

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.about: Suggestions are drafts written by AI from the conversation. They are never sent automatically: edit them into your own words before you send.
copilot.unavailableHint: Suggestions, nudges and summaries have paused. Risk keywords are still checked. Carry on as you normally would.
copilot.off: Copilot is off for your organisation.
copilot.beforeFirst: Suggestions appear after the talker writes.
copilot.useHint: Puts this text in your reply box to edit. Nothing is sent.
copilot.summaryEmpty: A summary appears after a few turns.
copilot.finalSummaryEmpty: No final summary was saved for this chat.

riskBanner.resourcesSent: Emergency resources were sent to the talker.
riskBanner.ackFailed: Couldn't save. The flag stays open until it's acknowledged.
riskBanner.noSupervisorAlerted: No supervisor could be alerted automatically — use Alert a supervisor or follow your organisation's emergency procedure.
riskBanner.raised: Raised from possible to high risk.

info.title: Talker
info.name: Name
info.endBody: The talker will see that the chat has ended. You'll then review the summary.

info.openRiskElevated: This chat has an open risk flag that hasn't been reviewed.
info.endFailed: Couldn't end the chat. Please try again.

summary.intro: Check the AI draft and correct anything that's wrong. It stays with this chat's record.
summary.draftTimeout: The draft didn't arrive. You can write the summary yourself.
summary.noFields: No summary fields are set up for your organisation.

wellbeing.body: That was a hard conversation. Before your next chat, take a few minutes for yourself: step away from the screen, breathe, have some water.
wellbeing.support: If you'd like to talk it through: {{contact}}

transfer.bodySupervisor: The talker is told their chat is being passed on. Their listener stays with them until another listener picks it up.

transfer.previousComposer: This chat is now with {{name}}. Only they can reply.

takeOver.title: Take over this chat?
takeOver.body: You become the talker's listener now, and {{name}} can no longer reply. Often a whisper is enough — take over when the talker's safety needs it.
takeOver.failed: Couldn't take over this chat. Please try again.

block.title: Block this talker?
block.body: This ends the chat now and refuses new chats from this device or network for 24 hours. The talker sees a neutral message.
block.reasonPlaceholder: Kept with this chat's record for your team
block.done: Talker blocked. The chat has ended.
block.failed: Couldn't block this talker. Please try again.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.intro: Live chats, the queue and who is on. Open a chat to read along, whisper to its listener, or step in.
monitor.browserAlertsBlocked: Browser notifications are blocked, so alerts only show while this tab is open.
monitor.listenersEmpty: No one is set up as a listener yet.

assign.title: Assign {{name}}
assign.body: Choose an available listener. The chat is held for them and they're alerted.
assign.noneAvailable: No listener is available with room for another chat.
assign.gone: Someone picked this chat up, or it ended.
assign.failed: Couldn't assign this chat. Please try again.

calibration.title: Risk calibration
calibration.explainer: How this organisation's risk flags turned out, as marked by the listeners who reviewed them. Use it to tune your risk threshold: many false positives from the AI classifier suggest it is set too low. Your Ally contact can change it.
calibration.empty_one: No risk flags in the last {{count}} day.
calibration.empty_other: No risk flags in the last {{count}} days.
calibration.byConfidenceHint: How the classifier's flags turned out at each confidence. Flags at or above your threshold ({{threshold}}) are high risk; below it, possible risk.

qa.title: Quality
qa.introSupervisor: Helping-skills feedback on finished chats, newest first. Each one is a snapshot of one conversation — use it to talk with the listener about how they're growing.
qa.introMine: Feedback on your finished chats, from the helping-skills rubric. It's here to help you grow, not to grade you.
qa.emptySupervisor: No chats have feedback yet. It appears a little while after a chat ends, for chats with enough conversation to review.
qa.emptyFiltered: No chats with feedback for this listener yet.
qa.emptyMine: No feedback yet. It appears a little while after a chat ends, for chats with enough conversation to review.
qa.overallHint: The average of this chat's skill scores, on the rubric's 1–4 scale. One chat is a snapshot, not a verdict.
qa.notFound: This feedback doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
qa.detailIntroMine: Read it alongside your own sense of the chat — what would you add? Talk it through with your supervisor if you'd like.
qa.detailIntroSupervisor: {{name}} sees exactly this. Start from what went well, then ask what they'd like to practise.
qa.wentWellEmpty: Strengths show here once a skill reaches score 3. Every chat builds them — pick one step below to start.
qa.toWorkOnIntro: One or two at a time is plenty. Each comes with a way to practise.
qa.toWorkOnEmpty: Nothing stood out to work on in this chat.
qa.practiseUnhelpful: Practise: in your next chat or roleplay, notice the moment before “{{behaviour}}” and pause before you reply.
qa.practiseMissing: Practise: make “{{behaviour}}” a deliberate step in your next chat or roleplay.
qa.closing: Thank you for being there for someone who reached out. Every conversation builds these skills.

team.title: Team
team.listenerExplainer: Takes chats with talkers: claims them from the lobby, replies, ends them, and sees their own feedback.
team.supervisorExplainer: Everything a listener can do, plus: monitors live chats, whispers to listeners, transfers or takes over chats, and reviews feedback.
team.lagNote: Changes apply at once. Someone already signed in may need to reload the page to see their new access.
team.empty: No one in your organisation yet.
team.adminHint: Admins are supervisors by role, so this can't be changed here.
team.listenerViaSupervisor: Supervisors can already take chats. Turn Supervisor off to change this.
team.failed: Couldn't update {{name}}. Their access hasn't changed.
team.noAccess: Team is for your organisation's admins.

restricted.title: Helpline is switched off for your organisation — you can finish your open chats
restricted.body: New talkers can't reach the helpline and the queue is closed. Your open chats carry on until they end.
restricted.elsewhere: This part of the helpline is unavailable while it's switched off. Finish your open chats from the Lobby.
